fit.low_rank: report and retain unidentified coefficients; no retune

cohorts: Separate exact target/host/boundary/emitter/ABI. No pooling C into Rust, CPU into GPU, owned into into.
dynamic_work: Features acquired by untimed execution of each exact frozen fixture. Output-dependent branch/filter work is known only after acquisition. This is offline diagnosis, not a cheap online predictor.
freeze: Freeze coefficients and all predictions before heldout timing evaluation/summaries. Preserve losses and unsupported cells.
default: Unchanged unless independently approved broad heldout acceptance; no runtime tracing/value scans.
cost_scope: Acquisition, instrumentation, oracle execution and setup excluded from fitted call timings and selector speed claims. JS carrier construction events are not V8 allocator calls or physical storage byte claims. Explicit copy operations only; native callback/shader/library work may remain unknown.
required_unknown: Retain baseline if any required component unknown, incomparable, absent or unbound.
